claims.description: Native `table` elements and supported table display values create table formatting boxes.

notes.text: table-cell-content verifies ordinary block, flex, grid, and styled inline descendants inside cells, including allocated-width reflow, point queries, and top/middle/bottom alignment. Full intrinsic column distribution remains outside the supported subset.
Native `table`, `caption`, `colgroup`, `col`, row-group, row, and cell elements plus authored table display values have parity coverage.
The implemented table subset is intentionally narrow and relies on explicit sizing for complex structures.

claims.description: Explicit table, column, row, and cell dimensions participate in supported sizing and spanning.

notes.text: Cell content contributes measured dimensions, but full intrinsic column distribution is not modeled.

claims.description: `border-spacing` and supported collapsed-border geometry affect table layout.

notes.text: Full collapsed-border conflict resolution is not modeled.

claims.description: `caption-side` placement and row-group ordering follow the supported table model.
Supported collapsed visibility and empty-cell behavior affect table geometry and hit testing.

notes.text: Complex table-specific `visibility: collapse` interactions are not modeled.

claims.description: `vertical-align: top/middle/bottom` places cell content; table layout algorithm hints remain limited.

notes.text: `table-layout` remains inert. Top, middle, and bottom cell alignment use measured content height; full cross-cell baseline alignment and other vertical-align modes remain unmodeled.
